posts.name: Koshnek
posts.cooked:
I had a question about this rule and one of AZ's cards Thermal Shockwave.

Thermal Shockwave: Power: Absolute Zero deals up to 3 targets 1 cold damage each. Absolute Zero deals himself X fire damage where X = the total amount of cold damage dealt by Absolute Zero this turn.

 

So if HP Reduced = Dmg Dealt, does that mean that if he deals two targets damage and heals himself, he only takes 2/3 of that number in fire damage?

If AZ had Focused Aperatures out and did 2 cold to two villains each and himself for 6 damage -2 heal = 4 cold damage, does he only take 4 fire damage with no other damage bonuses active? 

That's kind of cool if the case, because that means he really only takes 2 damage to deal 4 damage fire damage if he also happens to have Isothermic Transducer out.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked: You are correct, no hp is reduced, so no damage is dealt, in your example he would deal himself 4 fire damage.
posts.raw: You are correct, no hp is reduced, so no damage is dealt, in your example he would deal himself 4 fire damage.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Any damage healed by Null Point Calibration Unit doesn't count toward the fire damage he deals himself as a result of Thermal Shockwave.  Even if a target has 1 HP and you deal 2 cold damage it still counts as 2 cold damage towards the fire damage Thermal Shockwave would deal.
posts.raw: Any damage healed by Null Point Calibration Unit doesn't count toward the fire damage he deals himself as a result of Thermal Shockwave.  Even if a target has 1 HP and you deal 2 cold damage it still counts as 2 cold damage towards the fire damage Thermal Shockwave would deal.

posts.name: Koshnek
posts.cooked:
Cool. This was confusing me because at the time I asked the question I didn't realized it counted other sources of cold damage dealth during that turn. I have the box, but I play mostly on steam because I don't have many people to play with. I got confused when I had 6 health and did 4 damage and died! Now I realize that Impale didn't do me any favors :D.

 

Thanks for the quick replies!
